breezebornerefrain: Multiple wielders are assumed to have independent effects, with only the highest active refinement applying.
hereticsmoltenblade: Coordinate changes and movement events are added together; the same movement reported by both is counted twice.
hymnofthemaelstrom: A party-wide heal is assumed to generate one stack; separate heals generate separate stacks.
Each stack is assumed to have its own ATK cap, applied before the reaction boost.
Multiple wielders are assumed to have independent effects, with only the highest active ATK bonus applying.
